title: Did I Win? The Office Costume Contest
trend: TikTok 'Did I Win This Trend?' costume reveal (start in everyday clothes, beat drop, full costume reveal, ask 'did I win?'; SocialPilot late-October 2026 US list) + office Halloween costume contests in the final week before Halloween
length_reason: Quick one-clip reveal format (originals run well under a minute), so it stays at the short end; 180 s keeps it eligible for TikTok and Instagram too.
youtube_title: Did I Win? The Office Halloween Costume Contest
description:
Wes is sure his costume will win the office Halloween contest. Then the office dog and the broken printer enter.
Nobody expected the printer to work. Nobody expected the camera to be on.

#cartoon #animation #funny #halloween #office
tiktok_caption: the office costume contest got out of hand #cartoon #animation #funny #halloween #office

lines.text: Okay, Lorna. Three, two, one. Did I win?
Wes. You are wearing the same orange hoodie you wear every day.
Am I, though? Look closer.
I'm looking. It has a mustard stain from August.
That's not mustard. That's the costume.
Fine. What are you?
Robin Hoodie.
I'm the judge of this contest, and I would like to quit.
The prize is the parking spot right by the door. I need that spot.
I park so far away, I pass through a different weather.
The rules are simple. You walk in normal. The music drops. You reveal.
Then you look right at us and ask, did I win.
I've been practicing the face since July.
Watch. Did I win?
That face looks like you dropped your keys in a lake.
Excuse me. Next contestant.
Muffin, you're the office dog. You can't enter.
I have entered and won three years in a row.
How does a dog win three years in a row?
Nobody can look at this face and say no. Watch.
Three, two, one. Did I win?
Oh no. He tilted his head.
That's cheating. That head tilt is a weapon.
I came as a good boy.
You are a good boy.
Method.
Last year he came as a sandwich somebody left on a desk.
That wasn't a costume. That was lunch. It was Kevin's.
Kevin still talks about it at every meeting.
Pardon me. I should like to enter.
The printer? The printer talks?
Only on Halloween week. The rest of the year I just say paper jam.
Gerald, you've been out of order since the spring.
Correct. Which is why this is going to be terrifying.
Three, two, one.
Did I win?
Did he just print a page?
Double sided. In color. On the first try.
I have never been so scared in my life.
I've been hitting print since April. Where did all my stuff go?
Into a drawer in my heart, Wesley. Four hundred copies of your lunch order.
That's why nobody ever brought my burrito.
Okay. Scores. Wes, a two. Muffin, a ten.
Tilted.
Gerald. A printer that works on a Monday. That's an eleven.
Then I need a bigger reveal. Lorna, you do one.
I'm the judge. Judges don't reveal.
Wait. Why is my laptop camera light on?
Oh. I connected to it at nine. I was lonely.
Wes. You're in the all company meeting.
How many people?
Four hundred and twelve. And the big boss.
The big boss saw Robin Hoodie?
The chat is going wild. They're voting.
Read the chat. Read it slowly.
Accounting says the dog. Sales says the printer.
And the big boss says the guy in the hoodie.
Me? Why me?
Because you turned your camera on. Nobody has done that in three years.
Three, two, one. Did I win?
You won the parking spot, Wes.
I'll allow it. I don't drive.
And now, as a gift, I shall print your prize.
Paper jam.
And we're back to normal. Happy Monday, everyone.
Next year, I'm coming as the printer.
Next year, I'm coming as you. I already have the hoodie.
